name: MYO5A (lavender foal)
summary: MYO5A, lavender foal syndrome - a recessive lethal at birth. The real disorder comes with a diluted silvery coat, which is deliberately not drawn: the foal dies in seconds and phase 1 can only remove pigment.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: MYO5A (lavender foal) carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of lfs. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way lavender foal syndrome appears.

phenotypes.name: Lavender foal syndrome
phenotypes.description: A neurological defect that arrives with a diluted, silvery coat. The foal cannot stand, lies rigid with its head thrown back, and does not survive.
